# VCPeer

> VCPeer is a free, no-signup, peer-to-peer video calling and file-sharing site. A call or file transfer is a link — no account, no download, no time limit.

VCPeer gives a room link for peer-to-peer WebRTC video calls with no signup flow, direct browser-to-browser file transfer for sending large files without an account, free scheduling links for booking calls, and live streaming out to Twitch and Kick. It can also be self-hosted with Docker for teams that want to run their own instance.
